definitions: To be an improvement or advancement compared to someone else.
To be of a higher quality, status, or position than someone else.
examples: Her new job is definitely a step up from her old one.
Moving to a bigger apartment would be a step up from our current place.
He considers his new car to be a step up from his previous model.
lemma: to be a step up from someone
synonyms: to be an upgrade from someone
to be an improvement on someone
source: to be a step up from someone
